spec.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import re,json,os
p='inputs/chall/Carmine-Falcone.raw'
needles=[b'Falcone',b'Salvatore',b'disguis',b'contact',b'Infobreak',b'Carmine']
out=open(os.environ['OUT']+'/communication_hits.jsonl','w'); seen=set(); tail=b''; pos=0
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 while True:
  b=f.read(8*1024*1024)
  if not b:break
  data=tail+b; base=pos-len(tail)
  for needle in needles:
   for enc,n in [('ascii',needle),('utf16le',needle.decode().encode('utf-16le'))]:
    for m in re.finditer(re.escape(n),data,re.I):
     off=base+m.start(); key=(off,enc)
     if key in seen:continue
     seen.add(key); lo=max(0,m.start()-200); hi=min(len(data),m.end()+600)
     raw=data[lo:hi]
     if enc=='utf16le':
      lo=m.start()-min(m.start()//2*2,200);raw=data[lo:hi];text=raw.decode('utf-16le','replace')
     else:text=raw.decode('latin1')
     out.write(json.dumps({'offset':off,'needle':needle.decode(),'encoding':enc,'context':text})+'\n')
  tail=data[-1024:];pos+=len(b)
out.close();print('hits',len(seen))
PY
